description: This file contains utility functions related to reading file contents into memory and printing data for unit tests in the ut_control project. It defines functions like read_file_into_memory and print_input_output, which are used for test data preparation and display.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a memory buffer within a test_ut_memory_t structure, handling errors related to file access and memory allocation.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the content of a file and/or a supplied key-value pair string to the standard output for debugging or logging in testing.
